correctness.rationale: For every integer q>=3, acyclic sign arrays are exactly a union of two 3^q ternary product families with a 2^q common binary subfamily. Standard zonotope normal-fan facts identify them bijectively with distinct vertices. Explicit centered coordinate formulas, exact rational leaf diagonal moments, binomial hub-difference variance, and symmetry prove every covariance eigenvalue and eigenspace. Algebraic comparisons prove strict minimum and q=6 top-eigenaxis transition, plus the asymptotic. An independent-order combinatorial checker computes exact full covariance matrices for q=3..6, with an additional enumeration through q=9, while the infinite proof does not rely on experiments.

value.rationale: The uniform discrete vertex covariance of canonical complete-bipartite zonotopes is a motivated Euclidean polytope invariant distinct from the more widely studied face count, outer radius and interior covariance. The first non-cactus infinite bipartite family admits a natural ternary orientation model, and its complete exact eigenvalue/eigenspace classification reveals a sharp principal-axis switch at six leaves and a quadratic anisotropy law. The switch is a qualitative classification, not a small numerical improvement or an arbitrary parameter selection.
